text:
Jin Park: Heads-up: periodic review found a cluster of admin bindings with stale owners and a recent flurry of KMS:Bind events. Thinking we should run a tiny canary: snapshot -> dry-run scrub -> owner outreach -> ephemeral lock. Thoughts?

Leah Ortiz: Agree. Can you attach the CSV to the access-review board and tag me? I'll do owner outreach and coordinate attestation windows.

Jin Park: Uploaded s3://sec-reports/access/20260324-orphan-cluster.csv. Running `rbac-scrub --label=stale-admins --dry-run` in 30m and will paste diffs here.

DevSec Bot: Alert: 31 principals match label stale-admins; 5 principals show >4 KMS:Bind in 48h. Report: s3://sec-reports/access/20260324-orphan-cluster-report.json

Nate Bloom: If KMS binds line up with the orphans we should treat those keys as higher-risk. Suggest routing keys to KMS team for expedited rotation planning. Also propose staged lock: 20m ephemeral lock -> 24h disable.

Leah Ortiz: Staged lock + automated rollback is good. I'll draft outreach template (48h to respond). If no owner after 48h we move to 7-day temp disable then escalate for longer-term deprovision.

Jin Park: Dry-run results: top-10 diff attached. Sample: `svc-legacy-ingest@redwood` would lose project-admin binding; last_used 2023-08-11.

kms-bot: Noted keys with binds: projects/payments/key-rsa-03, projects/ingest/key-ml-07. Flagging for KMS rotation consideration.

DevSec Bot: Scheduling 15:10 UTC quick triage. Will post a short invite. If we enact locks we'll monitor error-rate and rollback if >1.5% increase in errors within 15m.

Jin Park: Cool. Keeping this canary tiny (top-10) to limit blast radius. Will report back after the sync with final decisions and attestation outcomes.

Leah Ortiz: Thanks all — will follow up with outreach progress and SRE rollback thresholds.
